findings.closed_scope: This round added no new large binary, kept its own evidence to text logs under .hgk/rounds/S4R3-.../, and did not delete or rewrite any historical raw receipt, tag or asset.
findings.reason: The .hgk/ evidence mass is a pre-existing 62 MB condition; shrinking it requires an owner-approved archival policy, not an executor decision.

The wheel built by the pipeline carries no schemas payload (pipd_ls_sp/*.py plus metadata only), so `pipd doctor` from a scratch cwd against a clean install of that wheel returns verdict=FAIL with `resolved schemas surface (mode=NONE)` and exits 1. The same command passes in the source tree, where the repository's own schemas/ directory is found - the defect is in the distribution, not the workspace. It was invisible while the wheel step's exit code was tee's, i.e. it is a direct consequence of the F001 masking.
findings.claim_ceiling: NOT repaired in this round and deliberately not worked around: no oracle was relaxed and no test was narrowed. Until it is repaired, the wheel this pipeline produces is not installable-and-diagnosable, so no green build receipt from this pipeline may be read as 'the package works'.
findings.next_action: Decide how the schemas surface is delivered with the distribution (package data inside the installed package, or an explicit resolution path), repair it, and re-run the wheel-and-clean-venv step unmasked until it is green.
